question: Which of the following is the largest west flowing river in Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Luni.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Luni River originates from Nag Pahar or Naga hills in the Ajmer district of Rajasthan and is the largest west-flowing river in the state.**
 
• Luni originates in the** Pushkar valley of the Aravalli Range, near Ajmer, and passes through the southeastern portion of the Thar Desert.**
 
• It ends in the marshy lands of** Rann of Kutch in Gujarat.**
 
• Luni River flows through **Ajmer, Barmer, Jalore, Jodhpur, Nagaur, Pali, and Sirohi districts of Rajasthan and the Banaskantha and Patan districts of Gujarat.**
 
• **Sukri, Mithri River, Bandi, Khari, Jawai, Guhiya, and Sagi **are the left bank tributary of River Luni.
 
• **Jojari **is the right bank tributary of River Luni.
 
• **Jaswant Sagar Dam, **built in **1892 **by **Maharaja Jaswant Singh** is one of the largest artificial lakes in India.
 
• **Sardar Samand and Jawai dam** are major irrigation projects on River Luni.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Chambal River** is a tributary of the Yamuna River in Central and Northern India, and thus forms part of the greater Gangetic drainage system.
 
• **Banganga River**, an 240 km long tributary of the Gambhir river in India, originates from the hills of Aransar and Bairath in the Jaipur region of Rajasthan state and confluences with the Yamuna near Fatehabad in Agra district of Uttar Pradesh state. 
 
• The **Banas **is a river that lies entirely within the state of Rajasthan in western India. It is a tributary of the Chambal River, itself a tributary of the Yamuna, which in turn merges into the Ganga. The Banas is approximately 512 kilometers in length.
